claim: Eight must-try Langkawi dishes with named stalls and RM prices: nasi lemak RM5-10, laksa utara, ikan bakar, satay, nasi dagang, coconut ice cream.
quote: Nasi Lemak ... RM5-10 at Dangau Langkawi. Laksa Utara ... mackerel or sardine broth seasoned with daun kesum, torch ginger, and lemongrass (RM8-12). Langkawi Satay ... freshly caught seafood, especially fish and squid.

claim: Langkawi dishes mapped to named stalls/areas with prices: Laksa Power RM5-8, Nasi Dagang Pak Malau RM8-12, satay RM0.80-1.20/stick, cucur udang RM4-6, night markets RM15-40/person.
quote: Laksa Power Pantai Airport ... RM5-8. Nasi Dagang Pak Malau (Jalan Makam Mahsuri) - RM8-12. Satay ... RM0.80-1.20/stick. Cucur Udang ... RM4-6. Kuah Town (6-10 PM): RM15-30/person; Pantai Cenang RM20-40/person.

claim: Local makan areas and Kedah specialties: Kuah mamak roti canai/teh tarik, nasi campur with rendang at Padang Matsirat/Ayer Hangat; look for tables full at 11am.
quote: Mamak stalls serving breakfast items like roti canai and teh tarik ... ikan bakar (charcoal-grilled whole fish) ... 'look for the places where tables are already full at 11am' rather than tourist-focused establishments.

claim: Kedah specialties include gulai nangka (jackfruit curry); cuisine leans spicy with tamarind and sambals, and Kedah is famous for seafood.
quote: Gulai Nangka, or known as jack fruit curry, is a traditional local delicacy in Kedah. Locals have a penchant for spicy food ... use of tamarind and sambals. Kedah is also famous for its seafood.

claim: Day-by-day Langkawi pasar malam schedule (Mon Ulu Melaka, Tue Kedawang, Wed/Sat Kuah, Thu Bohor Temoyong, Fri Ayer Hangat, Sun Padang Matsirat), 6-10 PM, mostly cash-only.
quote: Monday Ulu Melaka ... Wednesday Kuah Town (near Jetty) ... Largest market ... Hours 6-10 PM ... Most stalls are cash only.

claim: Corroborates the rotating night-market schedule by day and notes markets use heavy single-use plastic/styrofoam; bring reusable containers.
quote: Monday: Ulu Melaka ... Wednesday: Kuah Town ... Friday: Ayer Hangat (near Tanjung Rhu) ... markets extensively use single-use bags and styrofoam.

claim: Hole in the Wall is a floating restaurant and fish farm on Kilim River cooking freshly caught prawn, crab, snapper, grouper, lobster, sea bass and squid Malay/Thai-style; hand-feed stingrays.
quote: freshly caught seafood including prawn, crabs, red snappers, groupers, lobsters, sea bass and even squids ... Guests can even hand-feed stingrays.

claim: Hole in the Wall is Langkawi's only floating restaurant, ~7 min by boat from Kilim Jetty within the Kilim Geopark, resting on empty drums.
quote: the only floating restaurant in Langkawi ... about 7 minutes of boat ride along the river ... within the Kilim Geopark nature reserves ... rests on a series of empty drums.

claim: The floating restaurant is sold as a bookable floating-restaurant-plus-snorkelling day trip.
quote: Langkawi: Floating Restaurant & Snorkeling Trip - 2026 (Verified Reviews).

claim: Hole in the Wall has been owned and operated by Rahmad since 2003.
quote: It is owned and operated by Rahmad since 2003.

claim: Wonderland Food Store, Kuah, is an open-air riverside Chinese-Muslim seafood house; family of four eats for ~RM120 including beer; daily 18:00-23:00.
quote: A family of four can have a good meal for RM120 including beer ... situated beside a river ... 6:00 PM to 11:00 PM.

claim: Wonderland is among Kuah's longest-running, best-reviewed seafood restaurants; recommended softshell crab with salted egg, butter prawns, steamed grouper.
quote: among the Chinese-style seafood restaurants in Kuah and has been around longer than most, getting the best reviews ... softshell crab with salted egg yolk, butter prawns, and steamed grouper.

claim: Wonderland Food Store is listed by Lonely Planet among Langkawi restaurants.
quote: Wonderland Food Store | Pulau Langkawi, Malaysia | Restaurants - Lonely Planet.

claim: Pantai Cenang restaurant rundown: The Cliff (cliff sunset fusion), La Sal at Casa del Mar, Red Tomato, Kalut Cafe & Bar, Orchid Ria (Mother Loh, seats 250), Happy Happy, My French Factory.
quote: THE CLIFF ... beachfront cliff setting ... ORCHID RIA ... bursting full each and every night ... KALUT CAFE N BAR ... Best Mojito on island ... live rock & blues.

claim: Top seafood restaurants by area: Kapal Layar (Pantai Kok, boat-themed), Kelapa Grill (Tanjung Rhu), Hassan Ikan Bakar (Pantai Cenang), Langkawi Fish Farm & Weng Fung (Kuah), Telaga Arabic (Telaga Harbour), Pantai Grill.
quote: Kapal Layar ... boat-themed architecture and open-air terrace with sea views ... Kelapa Grill ... Tanjung Rhu ... Hassan Ikan Bakar ... Grilled fish marinated in spicy sambal ... Telaga Arabic & Seafood ... Telaga Harbour.

claim: The Gulai House at The Datai is an award-winning Malay-Indian curry restaurant in a rainforest kampung house with floor seating, 60 seats, dinner 18:30-23:00.
quote: award-winning restaurant nestled within the rainforest with traditional Malay kampung house design ... 60 seats and opens from 18:30-23:00 hours.

claim: The Datai Langkawi (Datai Bay) offers five restaurants including The Pavilion (Thai, open-air), The Dining Room (fine dining), a beach club, and The Gulai House, plus a garden-to-table cooking class.
quote: Five restaurants ... The Pavilion (authentic Thai cuisine in an open-air setting), The Dining Room (fine dining), The Beach Club ... and The Gulai House.

claim: The Datai's 2026 Chef Series brings Michelin-starred and award-winning visiting chefs for ticketed dinners through the year.
quote: The Datai Langkawi's 2026 Chef Series brings Michelin-starred chefs ... welcoming award-winning chefs from Europe and Asia.

claim: Four Seasons Langkawi (Tanjung Rhu) runs the Lesung Batu Cooking School for hands-on Malay cookery.
quote: Four Seasons ... Lesung Batu Cooking School.

claim: Casa del Mar (Pantai Cenang) offers a step-by-step cooking class preparing a 3-course Malay meal with the chef.
quote: prepare a 3-course meal with guidance from their Chef through a step-by-step demonstration focusing on Malay cuisine.

claim: Langkawi cooking classes and a Floating Lunch local cook-and-grill of fresh seafood are bookable food experiences.
quote: Langkawi offers food experiences including a Floating Lunch with local-style cook and grill featuring fresh seafood.

claim: Unkaizan is an authentic Japanese restaurant in Pantai Tengah known for fresh sashimi, charcoal grills and low-table seating.
quote: Unkaizan, nestled on Jalan Pantai Tengah in Langkawi ... known for its fresh sashimi and diverse menu ... options for low table seating.

claim: Unkaizan, led by chef Katsuji Takabayashi, was voted Malaysian Tatler's best restaurant in Malaysia six years running from 2005.
quote: led by its chef Katsuji Takabayashi ... The Malaysian Tatler magazine has voted Unkaizan as the best restaurant in Malaysia for six years in a row starting 2005.

claim: fatCUPID is a Pantai Tengah cafe in the grounds of La Pari-Pari run by three cousins cooking family Nyonya recipes plus Aussie favourites.
quote: tucked away down a quiet lane off the main Pantai Tengah strip ... set in the beautiful grounds of La Pari-Pari ... three cousins ... recipes from their family's rich Nyonya heritage.

claim: Langkawi duty-free: alcohol and chocolate are markedly cheaper than mainland Malaysia; chocolate ~50% off KL, spirits a third-to-a-sixth.
quote: Chocolate can be around 50% off compared to KL supermarkets, while certain brands of spirits can be a third or even a sixth of the price ... beer is very cheap.

claim: Duty-free Langkawi beer prices drop to ~RM5.97 (about USD 1.51).
quote: beer prices are as low as $1.51 / RM5.97, making Langkawi significantly more affordable than mainland Malaysia.

claim: Duty-free shops concentrate in Kuah town (~20 outlets) with additional centres in Pantai Cenang.
quote: Kuah is the capital ... main concentration of the duty free shops in Kuah Town and about 20 shops ... Pantai Cenang ... few duty free shopping centers.

claim: Nasi Dagang Pak Malau on Jalan Makam Mahsuri serves kampung-style nasi dagang with paddy-field views, RM8-12, paired with gulai ikan tongkol.
quote: a must-visit spot with beautiful paddy field views and authentic kampung-style nasi dagang ... RM8-RM12 ... pairing with nasi dagang is gulai ikan tongkol (tuna curry).

claim: Laksa Power serves laksa and cendol near the airport at sunset; Nasi Kandar Tomato in Pantai Cenang opens 12:00-23:30.
quote: Laksa Power restaurant ... cendol ... while you wait for the sunset ... Nasi Kandar Tomato at Pantai Cenang is open from 12:00 PM - 11:30 PM.

claim: June 2026 exchange rate is approximately 1 EUR to 4.6 MYR (1 MYR ~ 0.217 EUR).
quote: 1 EUR is equal to 4.6109 MYR ... 1 Malaysian Ringgit = 0.2169 Euros as of June 2, 2026.

claim: Langkawi street-food staples: cendol, pisang goreng, satay, onde-onde, Ramly burger at roadside stalls and night markets.
quote: Cendol - shaved ice with coconut milk, palm sugar syrup, and pandan jelly noodles ... Pisang goreng - deep-fried banana fritters ... Ramly burger.

claim: Best dry, sunny time to visit Langkawi is November to March (hot, ~33C, minimal rain); January is the prime high-season month.
quote: The best time for sunshine and outdoor activities is between November and March ... around 33C ... January is the best month to visit.

claim: Langkawi's monsoon runs September to mid-November with daily downpours; April and November are shoulder months avoiding the worst.
quote: The official monsoon season runs from September to mid-November ... April or November are good shoulder months ... avoid the worst of the Langkawi monsoon.
